Up to 500 recent app events are kept in memory and reset when the app process ends. Times are in UTC. Logs contain fixed status messages without coordinates, names, URLs or credentials. Copying includes app and device details; clipboard contents can be shared with other apps.
This removes recent diagnostic events from memory. Your journal stays on this phone. Previously copied logs remain on the clipboard or wherever you shared them.
